verdict: No semantic blocker in the repaired source under the recorded valid-input and pinned-source assumptions; build/no-loss/runtime acceptance remains a separate owner gate.

locked_anchor.shape: Program contains exactly info:&AccountInfo and zero-size PhantomData<T>, without repr(C) or repr(transparent).
locked_anchor.guards: Anonymous const size and alignment equality with &AccountInfo for the concrete Program type; target reference is a thin pointer.
locked_anchor.offset_reason: The only nonzero-size field occupies the entire guarded reference-size struct; a nonzero offset would extend beyond its size. It must be at offset0 in this locked shape. ZST field placement is immaterial.
locked_anchor.prior_evidence_correction: Earlier runtime evidence cited anchor-lang0.32.1; actual Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock pin0.31.1. This review hashes0.31.1 from both registry copies (identical).

Program_provenance_and_lifetime: The raw pointer is derived directly from a live borrowed Program; no integer address conversion occurs.
Reading the stored shared reference copies a Copy value, does not move/drop Program or AccountInfo, and retains the existing valid pointee/lifetime.
Program.as_ref and Deref return the same stored info reference, so pf.lamports and the original a.pump_fees.lamports identify the same Rc.
The volatile load supplies no synchronization and does not validate an arbitrary reference; correctness requires the actual private Program shape and existing validity.

Rc_ownership.type: Rc<RefCell<&mut u64>,Global> from event authority AccountInfo.lamports
Rc_ownership.sequence: ptr::read duplicates the Rc handle bits; original handle stays live. The temporary is not dropped: into_raw consumes/forgets it, increment_strong_count adds one, and from_raw restores exactly one additional owned Rc.
Rc_ownership.API_origin: The repair passes the pointer returned by into_raw to increment_strong_count, meeting the pinned API origin requirement; the original as_ptr spelling did not meet its documented precondition.
Rc_ownership.drop_balance: One additional strong owner enters the constructed AccountInfo and drops normally; neither the RefCell payload nor its inner &mutu64 is independently copied or dropped. No weak count or borrow flag is changed.
Rc_ownership.unwind_window: strong_count, valid read_volatile, into_raw, and the count increment have no panic-unwind path in the pinned implementation. If the volatile reference is invalid, behavior is undefined rather than recoverable; pinned count overflow aborts.
Rc_ownership.overflow: Pinned increment_strong_count uses the standard Rc inc_strong nonzero assumption, wrapping increment/store and overflow abort. The new clone is not given a wrapping-success or unwind behavior.
Rc_ownership.private_layout: This repaired sequence uses public Rc pointer APIs and introduces no additional manual Rc-header access. Existing3950 rcinc elsewhere still carries its separate private Rc-layout dependency.

limits: Conditional source/ownership reasoning, not whole-program equivalence or historical source proof.
Program private shape is locked-source dependent, not a stable public Anchor ABI.
Compile-time size/alignment equality alone is insufficient if the source field shape changes; retain the actual locked-source hash.
Single-threaded Rc use, a live initialized original Rc and valid Program references remain required.
Metrics, actual build artifacts and finite VM suites must be qualified separately by the owning runtime lane.
